alicechen.name: Alice Chen
alicechen.bio: Boards: bike shed ideas, cabin someday, things to cook after a ride.

bmartinez.name: Bob Martinez
bmartinez.bio: Bread. Only bread. Occasionally a shelf to put the bread on.

carolnk.name: Carol Nakamura
carolnk.bio: Deck refresh, dog-proof garden, kid-proof everything else.

p-5112.author: alicechen
p-5112.image: A small timber bike shed with a green roof and a sliding barn door
p-5112.text: Bike shed goals. Green roof, sliding door, room for three bikes and the one I have not bought yet. Saving this for the spring.

p-5116.author: bmartinez
p-5116.image: A sourdough loaf with a wheat-pattern score, deep golden crust, on a rack
p-5116.text: Scoring pattern I am finally getting right after a year. Wheat ear, shallow angle, one confident stroke. Saving so I remember which blade.

p-5125.author: alicechen
p-5125.image: A one-pan gnocchi dish in a cast iron skillet on a camp stove
p-5125.text: The Butter & Thyme gnocchi thing works on a camp stove. Made it after the Iron Horse ride. Saving for the next one.

p-5119.image: A cedar deck with built-in bench seating and a low fence gate
p-5119.text: Deck refresh idea: built-in bench along one side, low gate so the dog stays in and the kids stay out of the garden. Pinning before Jonah gives me a quote.
p-5119.author: carolnk
